improvements as the heads of such departments and agencies deem 
advisable, including facilities for maintaining supplies of fuel, oil, 
and other materials for operating aircraft.
(e) That whenever the President may deem it necessary for 
military purposes, the Secretary of War may assume full control of 
the airport.
